questions.subject: Science
questions.topic: Do Organisms Create Exact Copies of Themselves?
questions.stem:
Assertion: When gametes from two different plants fuse during sexual reproduction, the new plant that forms carries the number of chromosomes and the DNA content of a single plant rather than twice that amount, because the cells that give rise to the gametes hold only half the number of chromosomes and half the amount of DNA found in the non-reproductive body cells.
2. Reason: This halving of the chromosomes and the DNA in those cells is brought about by a process of cell division called meiosis.
Choose the correct option: (A) Both 1 and 2 are true and 2 is the correct explanation for 1 (B) Both 1 and 2 are true but 2 is not the correct explanation for 1 (C) 1 is true but 2 is false (D) Both 1 and 2 are false

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both 1 and 2 are true and 2 is the correct explanation for 1

evidence:
One solution that many multi-cellular
organisms have found for the problem mentioned above is to have special
lineages of cells in specialised organs in which only half the number of
chromosomes and half the amount of DNA as compared to the non-
reproductive body cells.

This is achieved by a process of cell division
called meiosis. Thus, when these germ-cells from two individuals combine
during sexual reproduction to form a new individual, it results in re-
establishment of the number of chromosomes and the DNA content in
the new generation.

options.A: Both 1 and 2 are true and 2 is the correct explanation for 1
options.B: Both 1 and 2 are true but 2 is not the correct explanation for 1

questions.subject: Science
questions.topic: Do Organisms Create Exact Copies of Themselves?
questions.stem:
Assertion: A flower of Hibiscus is described as bisexual, since it contains both stamens and pistil.
2. Reason: The petals and sepals are the parts of a flower that contain the germ-cells, and the number of these parts is what decides whether a flower is unisexual or bisexual.
Choose the correct option: (A) Both 1 and 2 are true and 2 is the correct explanation for 1 (B) Both 1 and 2 are true but 2 is not the correct explanation for 1 (C) 1 is true but 2 is false (D) Both 1 and 2 are false

evidence:
The flower may be unisexual (papaya,
watermelon) when it contains either stamens
or pistil or bisexual (Hibiscus, mustard)
when it contains both stamens and pistil.

Stamens and pistil are
the reproductive parts of a flower which
contain the germ-cells.

options.A: Both 1 and 2 are true and 2 is the correct explanation for 1
options.B: Both 1 and 2 are true but 2 is not the correct explanation for 1

questions.subject: Science
questions.topic: Do Organisms Create Exact Copies of Themselves?
questions.stem:
Assertion: A farmer who wants seedlings whose cells carry twice the DNA amount of the parent plant should collect the seeds formed by self-pollination, since self-pollination doubles the DNA of the offspring.
2. Reason: Self-pollination is the transfer of pollen from one flower to another, carried out by agents such as wind, water or animals.
Choose the correct option: (A) Both 1 and 2 are true and 2 is the correct explanation for 1 (B) Both 1 and 2 are true but 2 is not the correct explanation for 1 (C) 1 is true but 2 is false (D) Both 1 and 2 are false

evidence:
If each new generation is to be the
combination of the DNA copies from two pre-existing individuals, then
each new generation will end up having twice the amount of DNA that
the previous generation had.

If this transfer of pollen occurs in the same flower, it is
referred to as self-pollination. On the other hand, if the pollen is
transferred from one flower to another, it is known as cross-
pollination.

options.A: Both 1 and 2 are true and 2 is the correct explanation for 1
options.B: Both 1 and 2 are true but 2 is not the correct explanation for 1
